name: maker_respawn
about: An npc_maker spawns its child, and a second after the first dies (docs/vtmb/npc-ai/lifecycle.md § 'The NPC makers' and § 'CNPCMaker::MakeNPC 0x1034b7b0'). hw_hub_1's ratmaker_2 verbatim (use_interesting 0) (NPCType npc_VRat, NPCTargetname rat_2, Flag_StartDisabled 1, Flag_InfChild 1, MaxNPCCount 5, MaxLiveChildren 1, SpawnFrequency 5). Enable 0x1034b490 installs the base MakerThink 0x1034bbf0 at now; MakeNPC builds the child through the factory, names it rat_2, ++m_nLiveChildren and fires OnSpawnNPC (+0x6668); MakerThink re-arms at SpawnFrequency, and on a full live ceiling (1) spawns nothing. The child, killed by damage (TakeDamage 0x102c29a0, the corpus's own 500), dies through Event_Killed 0x10265ad0; the maker's DeathNotice (slot 139, 0x1034bc90) sees a dead child, fires OnNPCDied and drops the live count, so the next MakerThink (at most SpawnFrequency later) makes a second rat_2.
known_red: new: after the child's death (OnNPCDied at 4.05 s) the maker makes no second child within SpawnFrequency (MakerThink 0x1034bbf0 re-arms at freq)
notes: No never on a second OnSpawnNPC while the first child lives: the trace's output event cannot tell the two windows apart without a count (harness gap, triage-W.md).
